answer: A payout is split so that 47% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The trellis schedule is applied in delta and opal reveals each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2323 identities would post 1227 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
